facts.fact: The World Bank diagnostic states the government fibre network RAG, which interconnects public institutions in all nine districts, is managed by ANINF, though ANINF may lack the capacity to manage such extensive infrastructure; document published 2019-01-01, no event date given.

The diagnostic states the e-education project connects schools with line ministries through applications developed and managed by private providers; document published 2019-01-01, no event date given.

systems.tiers: central level only; document says in-house capacities to manage it are limited
